meta.description: The terms that apply when you plan and book a Singapore trip with Five Foot Way.

title: Booking Terms
intro: These terms apply to every trip planned or booked by {brand}, {address} ([{email}](mailto:{email})). Please read them before you confirm a booking. By confirming, you agree to them on behalf of everyone travelling with you.

p: {brand} plans trips to Singapore and arranges services provided by others, such as hotels, guides, transport and attraction tickets. Unless we say otherwise in writing, we act as your agent in arranging those services; the hotel, guide or other supplier is responsible for providing them, under its own terms, which we will share with you on request.

Our first reply and initial ideas are free and do not commit you to anything. When you ask for a full proposal, we send a written quote that lists the services included, the total price, what is not included, the payment schedule and the cancellation terms that apply. Prices on a quote are valid until the date shown on it. Prices on this website, where shown, are 'from' prices and are confirmed only in a written quote.

A booking is confirmed when you accept our quote in writing and we receive the deposit stated in it. We then confirm the booking to you by email. The balance is due by the date stated in the quote. If the balance is not paid on time, we may treat the booking as cancelled by you, and the cancellation terms below apply.
Payments are made by bank transfer or by card through a secure payment link. We never ask for card details by email.

If you want to change your booking after confirmation, tell us in writing as early as possible. We will do our best to help. Any extra cost charged by suppliers, plus our reasonable handling time, will be passed on to you, and we will tell you the amount before making the change.

You may cancel at any time by writing to us. Cancellation charges depend on how close to the start of the trip you cancel and on the suppliers' own terms, and are set out in your written quote. Any amount not owed to suppliers or for work already done will be refunded within 30 days.

Occasionally we or a supplier may need to change part of your trip, for example if a hotel becomes unavailable or a site closes. We will offer a comparable alternative and tell you as soon as possible. If we have to make a significant change before departure, you may accept it, choose an alternative, or cancel and receive a full refund of the money you have paid us. We are not responsible for compensation where the change is caused by events outside our control.

We are not liable for failures or delays caused by events beyond our reasonable control, such as severe weather, natural disasters, epidemics, government action, strikes, or airline and airport disruption. We will help you rearrange plans where possible.

ul: Hold a valid passport and any visa, transit or entry documents required, and complete the SG Arrival Card before arrival.
Check the entry and import rules that apply to you, including those on medicines, e-cigarettes and chewing gum.
Take out travel insurance covering cancellation, medical costs and personal belongings. We strongly recommend it.
Tell us before booking about any medical condition, mobility need or dietary requirement that affects your trip.
Follow local laws, park rules and the reasonable instructions of guides and suppliers.

p: We will plan and arrange your trip with reasonable skill and care. Our liability to you for any loss arising from our own service is limited to the amount you have paid us for that service, except where the law does not allow us to limit it, such as for death or personal injury caused by our negligence. We are not liable for the acts or omissions of independent suppliers, but we will help you pursue any complaint against them.

If something goes wrong during your trip, tell the supplier and us straight away so that we can try to fix it on the spot. If you remain unhappy, write to [{email}](mailto:{email}) within 30 days of your return, and we will respond within 30 days.

These terms are governed by the laws of Singapore, and the courts of Singapore have jurisdiction over any dispute. If you live in another country, you may also have rights under the consumer laws of that country.
